item.title: Dark - Walkthrough
item.description:
Overview

  • Attacker IP: 10.200.74.40
  • Target Machine IP: 10.1.113.43

The objective was to enumerate the target, identify exposed services, gain initial access by exploiting an unauthenticated WordPress privilege escalation vulnerability (CVE-2026-23550), and escalate privileges to root through Docker group membership.

Port Scanning

RustScan

The first step was identifying the exposed services running on the target.

rustscan -a 10.1.113.43 -- -A -oN nmap/rust

Results

22/tcp open  ssh     OpenSSH 8.9p1 Ubuntu
80/tcp open  http    Apache 2.4.52
                 WordPress 6.0

item.title: SQL Basics (Easy) - Walkthrough
item.description:
Hack Smarter - SQL Fundamentals Lab Walkthrough

In this lab, the objective was to complete four SQL missions by interacting directly with a live SQLite database. Rather than exploiting a vulnerable application, this exercise focused on understanding how SQL works from the database administrator’s perspective.

Before completing the missions, I first explored the database to understand its structure.

Step 1 - Identify the Database Type

The first thing I wanted to know was which database engine the application was using.
